desc: 百叶凉影下的薄款印花夏被，轻垂贴身、可水洗的夏日床品详情页
name: 百叶凉影薄款印花夏被款

shots.intent: 首屏用正午百叶斜影落在一条薄被上的凉感一眼建立夏日诉求，靠垂坠与轻薄而非蓬松保暖争取点击。
shots.textZone: 左上英文细体 kicker，两行主标题「{selling_point_1}」加 2px 柠檬菊下划线，其下竖排细字「{callout_1}」压在 1px 竖线上，右上切角方形芯片「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 干净的浅苔场正上方平铺主图，把被面花型、四边拼色带与包角一次看清，负责搜索流量的一眼点击。
shots.textZone: 仅右下角一枚切角方芯片「{callout_1}」，其余画面不放任何文字

shots.intent: 同一床同一俯角上下分屏，把厚被在夏天闷身、压腿、不贴身的真实不适摊开，制造换薄被的动机。
shots.textZone: 顶部深苔色带横排主标「{selling_point_2}」，两格右下各一枚切角方芯片「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 同一侧机位把厚被挺立的断面和薄被顺垂下来的下摆并排，让轻与薄的差别不用数字也能看见。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_3}」加英文 kicker 一行，两格底角各一枚编号方芯片「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 把薄被放回午后沙发小憩的真实动线里，用露出的脚踝和抱枕给出人体尺度，让买家代入自己家的客厅。
shots.textZone: 右上角切角方芯片「{callout_1}」，不加其它文字

shots.intent: 微距把拼色边带、滚边宽度和对角包边一次做实，用看得见的做工回答会不会脱线开边。
shots.textZone: 右侧 1px 竖线上的竖排短句「{selling_point_4}」加一枚切角方芯片「{callout_1}」，1px 虚线引到走线

shots.intent: 把被面主花型与反面小碎花在同一俯视框里翻开对照，一镜交代双面观感和真实薄度。
shots.textZone: 底部浅苔留白：小标题「{selling_point_5}」加三枚方芯片短标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 把可机洗与季节轮换收纳做成一格一步的结构化版面，用流程而不是形容词消除打理顾虑。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_6}」与英文 kicker；四宫格各一枚编号方芯片与短标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_4}」，水温与次数一律为占位符

shots.intent: 四张折好的同款并排，只差边带配色，把选款这一步一次做完且不印任何花色名称。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题「{selling_point_7}」，四卡下方各一条切角标签位「{callout_1}」至「{callout_4}」，花色名一律不印

shots.intent: 复用首屏机位把薄被折成一叠收进素布袋，用一床可带走的轻盈收住全页情绪并给出短促动作。
shots.textZone: 下方三分之一留白：主标「{selling_point_8}」，其下一行细字「{callout_2}」，一枚切角方形按钮填色 #E3C229 内一行行动文案「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: three fields only across the set: a real midday room with a pale moss plaster wall #EDF3E6 over a honed cool stone floor #DCE6D4, dressed in undressed cotton white #F7F8F3, with one off-frame louvered screen doing the drawing; clean graphic panels on pale moss #EDF3E6 built from straight-edged 8px-radius cards closed by a 1px double rule in #22301F and one citron #E3C229 top edge tab; and one full deep moss panel #22301F ruled in hairline citron #E3C229 reserved for care and trust screens; one clean copy zone per screen, never busy decor, no colour-block collage and no arch-shaped aperture card
style.direction: cool midday louvered-shade summer-textile commerce, built on crisp slat shadow and a thin low-loft drape rather than on sunrise warmth, oatmeal soft-focus bedding or dawn backlit sheer mesh
style.iconSystem: 2px square-outline pictograms stroked in #22301F sitting on solid citron #E3C229 square chips with one corner cut off, numbered square chips filled #58A55C with knocked-out numerals as the only numbering, 1px dashed citron leader lines to product parts, one small plus mark and one three-dot mark as the only ornaments, maximum six labelled elements per screen; no circular pips, no capsule pill labels, no outline circles, no dashed motion arcs, no 3D badges, no glossy seals, no certificate photos
style.lightingSystem: one high near-zenith noon key at 6500-6900K entering through an off-frame louvered screen at camera upper-left, so crisp narrow parallel shade stripes fall down and to the right across wall and fabric, plus a cool open-shade bounce fill that keeps the shadow side readable; exactly one believable contact shadow wherever textile meets a surface; no warm golden cast, no low sunrise rake, no rim glow, no specular hotspot on the binding, no second shadow direction; the single care screen on the deep moss panel keeps the same slat source, only dimmed

style.presentationRules: the campaign palette styles only backgrounds, cards, chips, rules and copy; the quilt keeps its own supplied face colour, print motif and scale, its solid edge band width, its piped binding, its corner mitre and any corner loops or fastening detail exactly as the reference shows, in every frame; it is always rendered thin and fluid, lying on a real bed, chair back or stone plinth with a believable contact shadow and never floating or propped up on invisible support; it must never be drawn thick, boxed, high-loft or corner-puffed the way a winter comforter sits; one real object always anchors human scale; wall lines, screen slats, card edges and plinth horizons stay straight and perspective-corrected; the eye-level slight 3/4 opening angle is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one place; at most one person in the whole set, anonymous, cropped from the shoulders down, no face, no hand grasping the product
style.surfaceSystem: honed cool stone plinth and floor #DCE6D4 with one soft matte reflection, pale moss matte plaster #EDF3E6, undressed matte cotton bedding #F7F8F3; the quilt itself is always a thin summer-weight textile in pale cream #F2EADC with a flat matte print face, a narrow solid edge band #E9B949 and a self-piped mitred binding, falling in long soft low-loft folds; never a thick puffy comforter, never a satin sheen, never a glossy or vinyl surface, never a quilted diamond grid the product does not have
style.typography: one tall narrow humanist Chinese sans family only; headlines set as tight two-line blocks in deep moss #22301F on light fields and knocked out in pale moss #EDF3E6 on the deep moss panel, each underlined by a 2px citron #E3C229 rule; one small letter-spaced uppercase English kicker in grass green #58A55C used as a graphic element; vertical Chinese captions set on a 1px hairline rule at the right edge; headline 28-36pt, sub-line 15-18pt, label 11-13pt, per-screen copy under 50 characters, Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」; no rounded soft-terminal face, no serif, no handwriting, no retro or cartoon face, no oversized English display word
